name: DeepSeek Harness
author: ziouf
description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) as a first-class Omarchy agent: runs the web UI as a background service, opens it as a dedicated app window, and feeds usage and balance to the Agents panel.

optional: rm -f "$HOME/.config/omarchy/defaults/agent"  # or pick another default agent
# restore the agent keybinding in ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua if rebound:
# remove the setup.default.agent.dsh entry from ~/.config/omarchy/extensions/omarchy-menu.jsonc if added
uninstall.notes: The background dsh web server runs as a child of omarchy-shell; removing the plugin stops it on the next shell restart.
